input.draft: Strict semantic table, chart, or diagram draft with factId/sourceChunkId-backed data

output: Strict DataVisualSpec with native semantic series, categories, values, claimIds, and derived source/fact refs
guarantees: Every numeric or categorical datum must match an existing spreadsheet fact and its owning source chunk.
Every datum must be cited by a selected grounded plan claim; unsupported claims are rejected.
Source refs are derived deterministically from accepted datum refs.
Unknown IDs, mismatched fact/source pairs, fact-value mismatches, and arbitrary fields are rejected.
prohibited: network, search, model, shell, filesystem, or image-generation actions
coordinates, dimensions, colors, layout, canvas, XML, or PPTX commands
